task_message:
Case N13: segment the peripheral nerve sheath tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 161x161x197 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The segmentation is complete and saved.

**Summary — Case N13 (peripheral nerve sheath tumor, T2-weighted MRI):**
- **Finding:** A large, lobulated, markedly T2-hyperintense mass in the posterior compartment of the right thigh (along the course of the sciatic nerve), with internal dark septations and a small superior nerve-tail lobule.
- **Method:** Seeded the model with two positive points on the axial slice through the mass centre, then verified the outline slice-by-slice in all three planes (axial 40–115, coronal 65–86, sagittal 70–105), zoomed on the boundary to confirm it hugged the bright core plus its darker rim/capsule.
- **Correction:** Accepted one intensity-based candidate (1.1 mL) representing the contiguous superior extension along the intermuscular/nerve plane.
- **Result:** Single connected component, 72.4 mL, extent axial 35–121, coronal 54–97, sagittal 68–116; final review showed no lesion tissue in the past-the-mask panels and no further candidates.
